# Intake Brief: Add a Favicon (CG-0MUTTXRWZ009NUB9)

**Priority:** medium · **Type:** chore · **Stage:** idea

## Problem statement

The Tableau Card Engine web app has no site icon. The GitHub Pages deployment,
the Vite dev server, and the packaged Electron desktop app all render with a
browser/OS default: neither `index.html` nor `public/404.html` declares a
`<link rel="icon">`, no web app manifest exists, and `electron-builder.yml`
declares no application icon. The deployed game launcher therefore has no
recognisable brand identity in the browser tab, bookmarks, or the desktop
taskbar/dock.

## Users

- **Players/visitors** of the GitHub Pages deployment — they want to recognise
  the TCE tab among many open tabs, bookmark a stable icon, and (on mobile) add
  it to the home screen with a proper icon.
- **Desktop players** launching the packaged Electron build — they want the app
  to show a real icon in the taskbar, Start menu, dock, and installer.
- **Contributors/developers** — they need a single, documented, reproducible
  source of truth for the brand mark so it does not drift between web and
  desktop surfaces.

Example user stories:

- As a player with many browser tabs open, I can identify the TCE tab by its
  distinctive tableau emblem so I can return to it quickly.
- As a mobile player, I can add TCE to my home screen and get the correct
  Apple touch icon.
- As a desktop player, I see the TCE icon in the taskbar and installer rather
  than the generic Electron icon.
- As a maintainer, I can regenerate every icon variant from one tracked source
  file with a single documented command.

## Acceptance Criteria

1. A single tracked **source-of-truth** icon file exists — the "tableau emblem"
   mark, authored as an original in-house SVG (permissive licence) that renders
   legibly at 16×16 and at 1024×1024.
2. `index.html` declares a favicon link, an Apple touch icon, and a web app
   manifest link; `public/404.html` declares the favicon link. All `href`
   values are **base-relative** so they resolve correctly under all three build
   bases (`/Tableau-Card-Engine/` for GitHub Pages, `/` for dev, `./` for
   Electron) without per-mode code.
3. `public/site.webmanifest` is served with `name`/`short_name`/`icons` and
   every referenced icon file exists in the production output.
4. The packaged Electron app uses the tableau emblem as its application icon on
   Windows (`.ico`), Linux (`.png`), and macOS (`.icns`). Generated icon
   binaries are produced from the tracked SVG at package time (the
   `electron-builder` resources dir `build/` is gitignored) via a documented
   npm script.
5. At least one automated test validates the change: a script/unit test asserts
   that an icon-generation run produces the expected artefacts from the SVG,
   and a build-output assertion confirms the generated `dist/` HTML/manifest
   reference the expected icon files that are present in the output.
6. All related documentation is updated to reflect the changes, including code
   comments, `README.md`, and any relevant docs-site entries; `public/assets/CREDITS.md`
   records the icon's licence/attribution.
7. Full project test suite must pass with the new changes.

## Constraints

- **Licence:** the emblem must be original/in-house or permissively licensed
  (MIT/Apache-2.0/CC0) and must be attributed in `public/assets/CREDITS.md`.
- **Single source of truth:** web and desktop variants must derive from one
  tracked SVG; do not hand-author multiple divergent copies.
- **`build/` is gitignored**, so platform icon binaries cannot be committed
  there — they must be generated by script (either committed under `public/`
  for the web, or generated at package time for Electron).
- **No new runtime cost:** the web favicon must not add a network request to a
  third-party host; assets are served from the app's own base.
- **Tooling:** `sharp` is already a dependency for SVG rasterisation; prefer it
  over adding new rasterisation dependencies. `electron-builder` can derive
  `.ico`/`.icns` from a single ≥512px PNG, avoiding extra packer dependencies.
- **Scope discipline:** no site redesign, no OG/social-preview image, and no
  per-game favicons — those are out of scope (see Risks).

## Existing state

- `index.html` — `<head>` has charset, viewport, and title only; no icon links.
- `public/404.html` — dark-themed standalone page; no icon link.
- `public/` — contains only `404.html` and `assets/` (no icon file, no
  manifest).
- `vite.config.ts` — `base` is `'/Tableau-Card-Engine/'` (production),
  `'/'` (dev), or `'./'` (electron mode); `public/` is copied verbatim.
- `electron-builder.yml` — `directories.buildResources: build`, no `icon`
  keys; `build/` is gitignored (only generated `tf-synths/` lives there).
- `src/ui/GameSelectorScene.ts` — existing branding precedent: inlines a GitHub
  Octocat SVG as a data URI (`preload`, line ~114).
- `package.json` — `sharp` present; no icon-generation script.

## Desired change

1. Author the tableau-emblem SVG and commit it as the tracked source (e.g.
   `assets/brand/` or `public/`).
2. Generate the web variants (favicon, Apple touch icon, manifest PNGs) and
   wire `<link>` tags into `index.html` and `public/404.html` using
   base-relative paths; add `public/site.webmanifest`.
3. Add an icon-generation npm script that rasterises the SVG with `sharp` and
   produces the Electron icon resource(s); wire it into the `package*` scripts
   so `electron-builder` picks up the generated icon.
4. Add the validation test(s) and documentation/attribution updates.

## Key Files (predicted)

- `public/favicon.svg` (or `assets/brand/tce-emblem.svg`) — new tracked
  tableau-emblem source; single source of truth for all variants.
- `public/site.webmanifest` — new web app manifest (`name`, `short_name`,
  `icons`, `theme_color`, `background_color`).
- `public/icon-192.png`, `public/icon-512.png`, `public/apple-touch-icon.png` —
  web variants rasterised from the SVG.
- `index.html` — add favicon, Apple touch icon, and manifest `<link>` tags.
- `public/404.html` — add the favicon `<link>` tag.
- `scripts/generate-app-icons.ts` (new) — `sharp`-based SVG → PNG/ICO/ICNS
  generation, runnable standalone and from the package scripts.
- `package.json` — add the icon-generation script and wire it into
  `package`/`package:win`/`package:linux`/`package:mac`/`package:steam`.
- `electron-builder.yml` — declare the application icon (per-platform and/or a
  single high-resolution PNG that electron-builder derives `.ico`/`.icns` from).
- `tests/scripts/generate-app-icons.test.ts` (new) — unit test for the
  generation script and/or a build-output assertion.
- `docs/DEVELOPER.md` — document the icon source, the generation command, and
  the base-relative link convention.
- `public/assets/CREDITS.md` — record the emblem's provenance/licence.
- `README.md` — brief mention if a developer-facing command is added.

## Related work

Manual (from context gathering):

- **Icon Style Guide (CG-0MLXIZVGK16S9S5A)** — completed; honour any existing
  icon conventions this established.
- **Move the version number on the menu page to below the GitHub logo
  (CG-0MSHQPDQ80015RF7)** — completed; Game Selector branding/layout precedent.
- **Add an ALPHA banner and version number to all game screens
  (CG-0MUI9K4F8009DYJL)** — completed; branding presentation precedent.
- **Deploy card games to GitHub Pages (CG-0MLTRXRKK1Q50Z0M)** /
  **Game Selector Index Page (CG-0MLTRTAWY0X0CSY4)** — completed; the deployed
  surfaces affected by this change.
- **Electron launcher for a Steam-ready binary release (CG-0MSMAD19O0084CAW)** —
  completed; the desktop packaging this change extends.

### Related work (automated report)

#### Related work items
- **CG-0MSMAD19O0084CAW** – Electron launcher for a Steam-ready binary release (completed)
- **CG-0MOYKQKJN009LFP3** – Repro & Artifact Capture (completed)
- **CG-0MOZNYQX70013RDG** – Docs & Migration Guide (completed)

#### Repository file matches
- `docs/DEVELOPER.md` — matched: add, app, asset, build, declare (+14 more)
- `AGENTS.md` — matched: add, app, asset, build, declare (+13 more)
- `README.md` — matched: add, app, asset, build, declare (+12 more)

## Risks and assumptions

- **Assumption:** an original tableau emblem is acceptable artwork — the
  producer confirmed option (a) "derived from the engine's own card assets,
  created as a new SVG" and will sign off on the final mark.
- **Assumption:** the `sharp` + `electron-builder` derivation path is
  sufficient; no additional `.ico`/`.icns` packer dependency is required. If
  `electron-builder`'s automatic derivation proves insufficient, a follow-up
  work item adds the packer rather than expanding this scope.
- **Risk — `build/` is gitignored:** generated Electron icons cannot be
  committed. Mitigation: generate them via a script wired into the package
  scripts; document the command. Decision on *where* web PNGs live (committed
  under `public/` vs generated at build time) is deferred to the plan stage;
  default recommendation is to commit the small web PNGs and generate only the
  platform binaries.
- **Risk — base-path breakage:** an absolute `/favicon.ico` would 404 on
  GitHub Pages. Mitigation: base-relative `href`s plus the AC5 build-output
  assertion.
- **Risk — over-scoping into social preview / per-game icons.** Mitigation:
  explicitly out of scope. Any additional opportunity (OG image, per-game
  favicons) is recorded as a separate discovered-from work item, not absorbed.
- **Risk — accessibility/legibility at 16×16:** document the failure mode;
  verify the emblem reads at the smallest size and simplify if needed.

## Appendix: Clarifying questions & answers

- **Q: What should the favicon depict?** (options: (a) a brand mark derived
  from the engine's card assets, (b) a producer-supplied official logo,
  (c) a generated TCE monogram) — **Answer (operator):** (a) a **tableau
  emblem**. Source: interactive reply. Agent recommendation was (a).
- **Q: Which surfaces must carry the icon?** (options: (a) browser only,
  (b) browser + Apple touch + manifest, (c) all of the above plus the packaged
  Electron app icon) — **Answer (operator):** (c) browser + Apple touch +
  manifest **plus** the Electron app icon. Source: interactive reply. Agent
  recommendation was (b); operator expanded scope to (c).
- **Q: How should the icon path be wired given the three build bases?**
  (options: (a) `public/` asset with a relative `href`, (b) Vite-processed
  import in `index.html`, (c) a `transformIndexHtml` plugin) — **Answer
  (operator):** (a) relative `href` from `public/`. Source: interactive reply.
  Agent recommendation was (a).
data.title: Add a Favicon

# Create ToneForge debug tool entry (`createToneForgeStatusTool`)

## Summary

Create a new debug tool entry in `src/ui/debug/` that reports the current ToneForge synth status and provides an on/off toggle. The tool captures a `SoundManager` reference at creation time.

## Acceptance Criteria

1. New file: `src/ui/debug/ToneForgeStatusTool.ts` exports `createToneForgeStatusTool(soundManager: SoundManager | null): DebugToolsEntry`.
2. The entry label is `'ToneForge'`.
3. The description is a function `() => string` that returns:
   - `'Active'` when `soundManager.isSynthActive()` is true.
   - `'Inactive'` when false.
   - Plus diagnostic detail: factory count and last load error (if any).
4. The `activate` handler toggles ToneForge: if active, calls `setSynthIntegration(null, {})` (detach); if inactive, the user can re-attach via the same entry (but since the soundManager reference is captured at creation, re-attach requires the caller to have set it back up — this is a diagnostic toggle, not a full re-initialisation).
5. The description function is called each time the panel refreshes, so it always shows current state.
6. When `soundManager` is null, description returns `'SoundManager unavailable'`.

## Key Files

- `src/ui/debug/ToneForgeStatusTool.ts` (new)
- `src/ui/debug/DebugToolsRegistry.ts` (re-export)

## Design Note

The toggle detaches the synth player on activation. Re-activating is the user's responsibility (they would need to call `setSynthIntegration` again). This is intentional: the tool is a diagnostic A/B toggle, not a full re-initialiser. The companion fix (CG-0MUTU0MFE0077H0F) addresses the underlying "ToneForge not active" issue.
data.title: ToneForge debug tool entry (createToneForgeStatusTool)

# Inject ToneForge entry into effective debug tools list

## Summary

Ensure the ToneForge status entry appears in the Settings panel Debug Tools section for any game that has a `SoundManager` with synth capability — **without requiring a game-specific registration change**. The injection happens at the engine level, into the effective debug-tools list.

## Acceptance Criteria

1. `CardGameScene.initSettingsPanel` (or the engine's effective list resolver) injects the ToneForge entry into the effective debug tools list in dev mode, **after** merging the game's own list with the engine defaults.
2. The injection de-duplicates by label (if a game already registered a tool labelled `'ToneForge'`, no duplicate is added).
3. For games that pass their own `debugTools` list (like Main Street), the ToneForge entry is still added to the effective list.
4. In production mode (`!isDevMode()`), the entry is not registered (tree-shaken by Vite's `import.meta.env.DEV` gating).
5. Main Street (without code changes) shows the ToneForge entry in dev mode.
6. Unit test verifies: entry present in effective list, de-duplication when game also registers ToneForge, absent in production.

## Key Files

- `src/ui/CardGameScene.ts`
- `src/ui/debug/ToneForgeStatusTool.ts`
- `tests/ui/CardGameScene.debug-tools.test.ts`

## Implementation Approach

In `CardGameScene.initSettingsPanel`, after computing `effectiveDebugTools`, check `if (isDevMode() && this.soundManager)` and push the ToneForge tool if not already present (de-dup by label). The soundManager reference is available since `initSoundSystem` runs before `initSettingsPanel`.
data.title: Inject ToneForge entry into effective debug tools list

# Author the tableau emblem SVG source

## Goal

Create the single tracked source-of-truth brand mark (the "tableau emblem")
as an original in-house SVG that every web and desktop icon variant derives
from.

## Context

Parent: CG-0MUTTXRWZ009NUB9 (Add a Favicon). The producer confirmed option (a):
a brand mark derived from the engine's own card assets, created as a new SVG.
The emblem must read legibly at 16x16 and at 1024x1024, use a transparent
background, and be square.

## Deliverable

`public/favicon.svg` (tracked, served verbatim by Vite from `public/`).

## Acceptance Criteria

- A single tracked source-of-truth icon file exists at `public/favicon.svg` - the tableau emblem - authored as an original in-house SVG under a permissive licence (in-house / CC0-style).
- The emblem renders legibly at 16x16 and at 1024x1024 (square viewBox; no hairlines that vanish at 16px); rasterising with sharp at both sizes produces a square, non-empty PNG.
- The SVG is self-contained and well-formed: no external references, web fonts, scripts, or embedded raster data.
- The file carries a short header comment stating provenance and licence for future maintainers.

## Minimal Implementation

- Hand-author `public/favicon.svg`: a simple, flat geometric tableau emblem (fanned cards / grid motif), min ~1.5px strokes at 16px scale, transparent background.
- Add `tests/scripts/app-emblem-svg.test.ts` asserting the SVG is well-formed, has a square viewBox, and rasterises with sharp to non-empty square PNGs at 16x16 and 1024x1024.

## Deliverables

- `public/favicon.svg`
- `tests/scripts/app-emblem-svg.test.ts`
data.title: Author tableau emblem SVG source

# Icon generation script (sharp) from the emblem SVG

## Goal

Provide a documented npm script that rasterises the tracked emblem SVG into
every required icon binary, so web and desktop variants can never drift.

## Context

Parent: CG-0MUTTXRWZ009NUB9. `sharp` (^0.33.0) is already a dependency and is
used by `scripts/generate-thumbnail.ts` and `scripts/contact-sheet.ts`. Web PNGs
are committed under `public/`; the Electron resource PNG (`build/icon.png`) is
generated at package time because `build/` is gitignored.

## Acceptance Criteria

- `scripts/generate-app-icons.ts` rasterises the tracked `public/favicon.svg` with sharp and writes the web PNGs (`public/icon-32.png`, `public/icon-192.png`, `public/icon-512.png`, `public/apple-touch-icon.png`) plus the >=512px Electron resource `build/icon.png` (1024x1024).
- An automated test (`tests/scripts/generate-app-icons.test.ts`) asserts that an icon-generation run produces the expected artefacts from the SVG (file exists, PNG signature, exact dimensions, square aspect).
- The generation script is idempotent, fails loudly when the source SVG is missing, and accepts an output-directory override so tests write into a temp dir without touching the repo.
- A documented npm script `npm run generate:icons` runs the generator (`tsx scripts/generate-app-icons.ts`).

## Minimal Implementation

- Add `scripts/generate-app-icons.ts` exporting `generateAppIcons({ sourceSvg, publicDir, buildDir })` plus a CLI entry point.
- Use sharp `resize({ width, height, fit: 'contain', background: transparent })` per target; verify sizes in the test.
- Add `tests/scripts/generate-app-icons.test.ts` calling the exported function against temp output dirs (happy path + missing-source failure).
- Add the `generate:icons` script to `package.json`.

## Deliverables

- `scripts/generate-app-icons.ts`
- `tests/scripts/generate-app-icons.test.ts`
- `package.json` (`generate:icons`)
data.title: Icon generation script from emblem SVG

# Wire web favicon, Apple touch icon and web app manifest

## Goal

Make the emblem appear in browser tabs, bookmarks, and mobile home-screen
installs on the GitHub Pages deployment, the Vite dev server, and the Electron
renderer, using base-relative links that need no per-mode code.

## Acceptance Criteria

- `index.html` declares a favicon link, an Apple touch icon, and a web app manifest link; `public/404.html` declares the favicon link.
- All href values are base-relative so they resolve correctly under all three build bases (`/Tableau-Card-Engine/` for GitHub Pages, `/` for dev, `./` for Electron) without per-mode code.
- `public/site.webmanifest` is served with `name`/`short_name`/`icons` (192/512 PNG) plus `theme_color`/`background_color`, and every referenced icon file exists in the production output.
- A build-output assertion confirms the generated `dist/` HTML/manifest reference the expected icon files that are present in the output, for all three modes.

## Minimal Implementation

- Add to `index.html`: `<link rel="icon" type="image/svg+xml" href="favicon.svg">`, `<link rel="apple-touch-icon" href="apple-touch-icon.png">`, `<link rel="manifest" href="site.webmanifest">`; add the favicon link to `public/404.html`.
- Add `public/site.webmanifest`.
- Add `tests/electron/app-icon-build-output.test.ts` following the real-build pattern in `tests/electron/vite-base-gating.test.ts`: build each mode into a temp dir and assert the emitted hrefs + that the referenced files exist in the output.

## Deliverables

- `index.html`, `public/404.html`, `public/site.webmanifest`
- `tests/electron/app-icon-build-output.test.ts`

# Electron application icon (Windows/Linux/macOS)

## Goal

The packaged desktop app and its installer show the tableau emblem instead of
the default Electron icon.

## Acceptance Criteria

- The packaged Electron app uses the tableau emblem as its application icon on Windows (`.ico`), Linux (`.png`), and macOS (`.icns`) via `electron-builder.yml` icon configuration, with electron-builder deriving `.ico`/`.icns` from the generated >=512px `build/icon.png`.
- Generated icon binaries are produced from the tracked SVG at package time (the `build/` resources dir is gitignored) via the documented `npm run generate:icons` script, wired into `package`, `package:win`, `package:linux`, `package:mac`, and `package:steam`.
- A test asserts `electron-builder.yml` declares the icon resource (win/linux/mac plus NSIS installer/uninstaller icons) and that each package script invokes the generation step.
- The full project test suite passes with the new changes.

## Minimal Implementation

- Add `win.icon`, `linux.icon`, `mac.icon` (pointing at `build/icon.png`) and NSIS `installerIcon`/`uninstallerIcon` to `electron-builder.yml`.
- Prepend `npm run generate:icons &&` to the five `package*` scripts.
- Add `tests/electron/app-icon-packaging.test.ts` parsing `electron-builder.yml` + `package.json`.

## Deliverables

- `electron-builder.yml`, `package.json`
- `tests/electron/app-icon-packaging.test.ts`

# Plan Complete — Add a Favicon (CG-0MUTTXRWZ009NUB9)

Effort: Small · Risk: Medium · Pre-check decision: **plan** (auto-skip not
eligible because risk is Medium) · Plan-approval gate: **not required**
(effort Small AND risk Medium → below the Medium-effort / High-risk gate).

## Feature plan (5 features, 7/7 parent ACs covered)

| # | Feature | Type | Depends on | Parent ACs |
|---|---------|------|------------|------------|
| 1 | Author tableau emblem SVG source (CG-0MUU3Q2UV003F1H2) | task | — | AC 1 |
| 2 | Icon generation script from emblem SVG (CG-0MUU3Q3C8007AGQ5) | task | 1 | AC 4, AC 5a |
| 3 | Wire web favicon, touch icon and manifest (CG-0MUU3Q3TT008HF5Q) | feature | 2 | AC 2, AC 3, AC 5b |
| 4 | Package Electron app icons from emblem (CG-0MUU3Q4AM0090MHF) | task | 2 | AC 4, AC 7 |
| 5 | Document icon source and attribution (CG-0MUU3Q4RS004VMMI) | docs | 1,2,3,4 | AC 6 |

Each feature is developed test-first (its test file is written before/with the
implementation in the same slice), so no separate horizontal test phase is
needed. Feature 2's generation-contract test is the prerequisite verification
for features 3 and 4.

## Vertical-slice verification

- **Slice A (web, end-to-end):** features 1+2+3 cut through authoring (SVG) →
  generation (sharp) → web wiring (index.html/404/manifest) → build-output
  assertion. Result: the emblem shows in the browser tab across all three build
  bases.
- **Slice B (desktop, end-to-end):** feature 4 cuts through generation →
  electron-builder config → package scripts → config test. Result: the packaged
  app/installer uses the emblem.
- **Slice C (handoff):** feature 5 documents source, generation command,
  base-relative convention, and attribution.
- Between phases: re-read the next child's description and update it against
  what the previous slice actually implemented before starting it.

## Decisions & assumptions (documented, not invented)

- **Chosen depiction:** (a) an original in-house "tableau emblem" SVG — producer
  confirmed in the intake Appendix.
- **Chosen surfaces:** (c) browser favicon + Apple touch icon + web manifest +
  packaged Electron app icon — producer expanded scope to (c).
- **Chosen wiring:** (a) a `public/` asset referenced with a base-relative
  `href` (no `./`, no leading `/`) so Vite serves it unchanged under
  `/Tableau-Card-Engine/`, `/`, and `./`.
- **Web PNGs are committed** under `public/` (small, deterministic); only the
  Electron resource `build/icon.png` is generated at package time because
  `build/` is gitignored. This follows the intake risk mitigation.
- **`.ico`/`.icns` are derived by electron-builder** from the generated
  ≥512px `build/icon.png` (no new packer dependency), matching the intake
  constraint "electron-builder can derive .ico/.icns from a single ≥512px PNG".
- **Out of scope** (explicitly): site redesign, OG/social-preview image,
  per-game favicons. Any such opportunity is recorded as a new `discovered-from`
  work item, not absorbed here.

## Open questions

None. All three intake Appendix questions are answered; the two deferred
decisions (web PNG location, .ico/.icns derivation) are resolved above with the
intake's own recommended defaults.

## Plan: changelog

- 2026-10-04 · plan skill · decomposed into 5 children, wired 7 dependency
  edges, coverage review returned `proceed` (5 children, 18 ACs), stage advanced
  to `plan_complete`.

## Appendix: questions asked this session

No new clarifying questions were required — the intake Appendix already records
the three decisions that shape this plan:

- **Q: What should the favicon depict?** — A (operator): (a) a **tableau
  emblem**, an original in-house SVG. Final: (a).
- **Q: Which surfaces must carry the icon?** — A (operator): (c) browser +
  Apple touch + manifest **plus** the Electron app icon. Final: (c).
- **Q: How should the icon path be wired given the three build bases?** —
  A (operator): (a) a `public/` asset with a base-relative `href`. Final: (a).

Research this session (evidence): confirmed `public/` holds only `404.html` +
`assets/`; `index.html` and `public/404.html` declare no icon links;
`electron-builder.yml` has `directories.buildResources: build` and no `icon`
keys; `package.json` lists `sharp ^0.33.0` and no icon script; the real-build
test pattern to extend lives in `tests/electron/vite-base-gating.test.ts`.
